title: Gemini 3.1 Pro: Frontier Reasoning (2026)
hook: Gemini 3.1 Pro pushes core reasoning past the Gemini 3 Pro baseline, scoring 77.1% verified on ARC-AGI-2 - a benchmark built to resist the memorization that inflates other scores.
key_points: A step up in core reasoning over the Gemini 3 Pro baseline, aimed at complex problem-solving.
Coding capabilities including animated SVGs, interactive 3D experiences, and web design.
Google cites a 77.1% verified score on ARC-AGI-2, a benchmark designed to resist memorization.
Available in preview via the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Gemini CLI, and Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise.
In the Gemini app and NotebookLM for Pro/Ultra subscribers.
content_html: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.1 Pro in February 2026, a step up in core reasoning over the Gemini 3 Pro baseline aimed at complex problem-solving. Google cites a 77.1% verified score on ARC-AGI-2, a benchmark built specifically to resist the memorization that can inflate results elsewhere.
extra_html:
What's new

The focus is reasoning on hard problems, paired with stronger coding - generating animated SVGs, interactive 3D experiences, and web design. The headline number is the 77.1% verified score on ARC-AGI-2; because that benchmark is designed to resist memorization, a high score is meant to reflect genuine generalization rather than recall.

Why it matters

ARC-AGI-2 is constructed so that pattern-matching against training data does not help, so progress there is a closer proxy for the kind of reasoning that transfers to novel problems. Gemini 3.1 Pro is available in preview via the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Gemini CLI, and Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise, plus the Gemini app and NotebookLM for Pro/Ultra subscribers. See Google's announcement for details.
